summary: Essential Properties Realty Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 1, 2026, solely to report a routine quarterly dividend declaration. The Board declared a $0.32 per share cash dividend for Q2 2026, annualized to $1.28 per share, a 3% increase from the prior quarter. The dividend is payable July 14, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. There are no M&A, tender, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. This is a standard current report on capital allocation, not a special situation event.
